newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela paid debt arrears of $654 mln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela paid debt arrears of $654 mln in 1996.

text.p: Venezuela paid foreign debt arrears of $654 million in 1996, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said Wednesday.
"In 1996 there are no arrears. We have made payments of $654 million on debt due since 1991," Matos said during a breakfast meeting with foreign journalists.
Matos said 493 million bolivars ($1.04 million) worth of domestic debt had also been paid off.
The only outstanding arrears from 1996 -- $40 million owed creditors by the Caracas Metro -- will be paid off in the next few days, he said.
